mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances following a 3-month RSAFS decline, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent earnings downgrades.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with immediate market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with subsequent earnings downgrades.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPI does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the simultaneous decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the tight labor market conditions do not correlate with subsequent market upturns.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates stimulate economic activity and increase risk appetite.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances during an easing cycle despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent market upturns.
